question: Should this external PR be allowed to merge without a live node approval-unavailable recovery run?
rationale: Source, focused tests, history, and documented CLI contracts support the implementation, but repository policy treats after-fix real behavior proof as a merge gate and the current protected label reserves any exception for a maintainer.

options.title: Require live recovery proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until a redacted node run shows the new message, printed Control UI URL, and successful approval-inbox handoff.

options.title: Record a proof override
options.body: Accept the focused Testbox boundary coverage because the patch is limited to recovery copy and propagation of already-known metadata.

recommendation.title: Require live recovery proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until a redacted node run shows the new message, printed Control UI URL, and successful approval-inbox handoff.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and recently repaired the affected shared renderer and placed the PR under protected human review.
